SELECT t.date, t.temperature, t.humidity, t.windSpeed FROM (
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(w.report_time,'%Y-%m-%d') AS date, ROUND(AVG(w.temperature),1) AS temperature, ROUND(AVG(w.humidity),1) AS humidity, ROUND(AVG(w.wind_speed) / 3.6, 1) AS windSpeed, 1 AS priority FROM ld_agri_weather_live w WHERE w.park_id = #{parkId} AND w.report_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{historyDays} DAY) AND w.report_time < CURDATE() GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(w.report_time,'%Y-%m-%d')
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(f.forecast_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS date, ROUND((f.temp_max+f.temp_min)/2,1) AS temperature, f.humidity_avg AS humidity, NULL AS windSpeed, 2 AS priority FROM ld_agri_weather_forecast f WHERE f.park_id = #{parkId} AND f.forecast_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{historyDays} DAY) AND f.forecast_date < CURDATE() AND f.id = ( SELECT f2.id FROM ld_agri_weather_forecast f2 WHERE f2.park_id = f.park_id AND f2.forecast_date = f.forecast_date ORDER BY f2.fetch_time DESC, f2.id DESC LIMIT 1 )
) t
WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ld_agri_weather_live l WHERE l.park_id = #{parkId} AND DATE_FORMAT(l.report_time,'%Y-%m-%d') = t.date )
OR t.priority = 1
ORDER BY t.date ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(w.report_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, DATE_FORMAT(w.report_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS reportTime, w.temperature AS temperature, w.humidity AS humidity, ROUND(w.wind_speed / 3.6, 2) AS windSpeed FROM ld_agri_weather_live w WHERE w.park_id = #{parkId} AND w.report_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN w.report_time >= CURDATE() AND w.report_time < DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, w.report_time DESC, w.id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(f.forecast_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, f.temp_max AS tempMax, f.temp_min AS tempMin, CASE WHEN f.temp_max IS NOT NULL AND f.temp_min IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND((f.temp_max + f.temp_min) / 2, 1)
WHEN f.temp_max IS NOT NULL THEN f.temp_max
WHEN f.temp_min IS NOT NULL THEN f.temp_min
ELSE NULL END AS temperature, f.humidity_avg AS humidity, f.wind_scale_day AS windScaleDay, f.remark2 AS rawForecastJson, f.weather_text_day AS weatherTextDay, f.weather_text_night AS weatherTextNight FROM ld_agri_weather_forecast f WHERE f.park_id = #{parkId} AND f.forecast_date > CURDATE() AND f.forecast_date <= DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{forecastDays} DAY) AND f.id = ( SELECT f2.id FROM ld_agri_weather_forecast f2 WHERE f2.park_id = f.park_id AND f2.forecast_date = f.forecast_date AND f2.fetch_time IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f2.fetch_time DESC, f2.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY f.forecast_date ASC
